purpose: Human-readable projection of what agents changed in response to a page thread.
grouping: by semantic page, never as one mixed note feed

unread.rule: A terminal result with null seen_at is unread.
unread.mark_seen_only_when: the human explicitly opens that result

candidate_vs_served.candidate: May be previewed in PAGE HOST without becoming product authority.
candidate_vs_served.served: May reload the current page only after Served identity/URL is actually verified by the executing owner.

ui.global: compact page list with pending counts and one minimal unread dot
ui.page: chronological pending observations + execution results + HACER
ui.notification_rule: Do not create a dashboard; indicators remain minimal and contextual.
